review.imagery: Root inspected every current official-page image and twenty brochure resources. Three own phase-one assets were selected. Generic landscape, lifestyle, monorail and architectural-reference images were excluded. Interior scenes remain omitted because no release-specific home interior was established.
review.floorPlans: Root visually inspected the complete phase-one page 32 and original MAG plot 35 image, including its dimensions, both area bases, G+2 and four 3 m setbacks. No bedroom count was inferred from four permitted townhouses. The brochure is contextual PDF support, with the original plot JPEG separately linked.
review.location: Complete physical page 17 visually checked for all eleven times. The current official active-project JS explicitly names Ardh and publishes 25.124043, 55.436185. Its community scope and unverified visitor entrance are explicit. The whole road diagram on page 18 was also reviewed.
review.provenance: The original 35-page, 38,040,181-byte FullStory PDF was publicly retrieved during the completed 2 November research and retained unchanged. Current endpoint HTTP 401 is explicitly disclosed. No access challenge or form was bypassed. Original source bytes and dated SHA receipts are retained.

unavailable: Individual approved home floor plans and project-specific home interiors remain unavailable. The archived FullStory brochure currently returns HTTP 401. Exact visitor entrance and live journey times remain unverified.
